evidence:
Walked instruction.md (17 lines) and /instructions/hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 plus integration.md line by line against solution/app. Every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation:
- Runtime: server.js -> src/index.js worker; bootstrap.js answers GET /api/health before DB work (start() request handler) and listens on PORT||3000 at 0.0.0.0; db.js DB_PATH||/app/app.db; seed read beside the module (src/seed_data.json sha256 a1c65c80... identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json); seedIfEmpty seeds only when users is empty; UI served by express.static from the same process (index.js:42-43).
- Sign-in for all 10 accounts with Hireops!2026 (db.js seedIfEmpty; index.js:84-92); 401 without session, 403 by role, 404 for a candidate asking about another application (index.js:73-81, 121-131, 326-333, 378-385).
- Jobs and candidates: recruiter-only Open job with title/team/hiring manager chosen from hiring-manager accounts/1-50 places (index.js:202-214; board.js:61-81); Add candidate with name/email/source, email shape check and case-insensitive per-job duplicate refused at the email field with typed values kept (index.js:216-233; board.js:41-60); a candidate-account email links ownership (index.js:225,229); workspace-generated ids (index.js:60).
- Board: six stages in order with Rejected as the last column (board.js:25-31); one stage at a time, reject from any stage but Hired with a non-blank reason, rejected_from remembered, reopen only to that stage clearing the reason (index.js:238-265, 311-314); ordinary-control moves via per-card select + Move and Up/Down re-order, drag optional (board.js:208-243, 300-319); shared persistent order (positions in SQLite via writeColumn); Interview capacity incl. the bulk set and freed places (index.js:290-295), shown in the column head (board.js:327); hiring-manager scope limited to own job and Interview/Offer/Hired incl. reject/reopen rules (index.js:257-264; board.js:144-162); observer/candidate move nothing.
- Concurrency: per-card version; stale move gets 409 naming who changed it via the card's last activity line (index.js:241-245); optimistic move then put-back with the reason and focus on the card's controls (board.js:166-205).
- Bulk move all-or-nothing in board order (index.js:274-321, 339-344; bulk bar board.js:277-290); undo of own latest move, single or bulk, restoring stage/place/reason, refused if any card changed since or Interview would overfill, single-use, superseded by a later move (index.js:165-168, 348-373; board.js:291-299).
- Internal notes: card detail panel with notes; recruiter any card, HM own jobs, observer read-only; unsaved note kept per person per card in localStorage (index.js:386-398; board.js:85-141; keep keyed by user id app.js:74-78).
- Activity: job opening/add/move/reject (with reason)/reopen/reorder/undo logged as readable lines with the actor; view newest first, all jobs or one chosen job, append-only (index.js:195-198, 211, 230, 266-271, 315-316, 366; app.js:80-120).
- Live updates: SSE 'changed' after every successful write; the page re-reads /api/bootstrap and patches keyed nodes in place so the open card, typed text, focus and scroll survive (index.js:45-54, 102-107; app.js:165-199; board.js:321-341; threads.js:36-65, 145-159).
- Conversations: role access as rules section 6 (index.js:114-131); non-blank plain text with line breaks kept (styles.css:105 pre-wrap); Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused after send, failure keeps text (threads.js:183-201); opens on latest 30 with earlier pages of 30 and the remaining count, scroll anchored (index.js:409-416; threads.js:160-175); arrival while scrolled up keeps place, shows 'N new messages', stays unread (threads.js:145-159); per-person unread per conversation plus total nav badge (index.js:132-139; app.js:150-156; threads.js:221); seen receipt on the sender's latest message with the observer excluded (index.js:143-156; threads.js:76-83); per-person per-conversation drafts surviving switch, reload and session loss with a re-sign-in prompt, invisible to other users (threads.js:112, 124, 182, 196; app.js:69, 224-230).
- Candidate view: 'My applications' list with job title, team and candidate wording from seed labels, own conversations only, none opened at sign-in (index.js:171-176; threads.js:7, 27, 52-53); the candidate read model omits notes, reasons, rejected_from, positions, other candidates and activity; board/activity/staff actions refused.
Run evidence: raw-evidence-index.json entries verified (each artifact sha256 matches and every matching_source_files hash equals the frozen task bytes). qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json records 25/25 scripted golden groups passed with page_errors [] (e.g. 14 open job/add/duplicate email at field/reorder/full Interview put back with focus; 17 live board arrival 805 ms keeping open card, note draft and focus; 18 paging and arrival while reading; 19 drafts/Enter/seen/unread; 21 session ended mid-draft; 22 observer; 23 restart). board.png shows Board/Conversations(badge)/Activity nav, undo button, Interview places header, Add candidate and Open job forms; its empty email field is because workspace.cjs:303 clears the fields after asserting the typed name was kept (line 302), not an app defect.
Probes: a plausible broken reference (no Activity job filter, no note-draft persistence, no add-candidate or open-job UI, candidate list auto-opening a conversation) is not what ships; each is implemented in source. A conforming alternative (polling instead of SSE, different layout/names/routes) is not constrained by this row. Only source-verified (not separately scripted): Activity per-job filter and candidate-account ownership of a newly added application; both are straightforward in source (app.js:100, 117; index.js:225-229). Minor non-blocking observation: a 4xx send refusal shows the server message (e.g. 'Write a message before sending.') without the words 'not sent', while the text stays in the box; the network-failure path says 'Not sent.' (threads.js:194).
